title: Tiny, cute robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#2b2b4a'/>
  <!-- body base (dark slate lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='32' ry='20' fill='#5a5f8e'/>
  <!-- body top disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='32' ry='18' fill='#8b90c2'/>
  <!-- rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='32' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#b8bce8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bumper front -->
  <path d='M18 66 Q18 84 50 86 Q82 84 82 66' fill='none' stroke='#c95d7a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='58' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='58' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='68' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='68' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 70 Q50 76 56 70' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little sensor dome (lidar) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#7fc8e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='41' r='2' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- side wheels peeking -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3f4370'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3f4370'/>
  <!-- little led dots on body -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='1.6' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='1.6' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='1.6' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
